requirements.description: Monthly stock returns, prices, shares outstanding, and volume for the July 1963-July 1995 sample (plus warm-up months for formation windows): value-weighting weights, 6/12/36-month formation returns, IM(L,H) holding returns, dollar trading volume.

Point-in-time security classification for the universe filter (shrcd 10/11, exchcd 1/2/3) and time-varying 2-digit SIC codes used to form the 20 industry portfolios monthly, per the paper's use of the CRSP SIC time series.
CRSP value-weighted index monthly return for beta estimation (footnote 25: regression on the CRSP value-weighted index) and the equal-weighted index referenced in Section III.A.2.

Compustat annual fundamentals for book equity (Daniel-Titman 5x5 and DGTW 5x5x5 characteristic sorts, Table VI BE/ME regressor): total assets, common equity, deferred taxes and investment tax credits, preferred stock, current/long-term debt, stockholders' equity.
CRSP-Compustat link to join Compustat book equity to CRSP permnos for the characteristic sorts and FM regressions (January 1973-July 1995 subperiod).

Fama-French monthly factors and risk-free rate: the 3-month T-bill rate for excess returns (Table I) and Mkt-RF/SMB/HML for the Section III.A.2 serial-covariance checks on the factor-mimicking portfolios.
